questions.def: Past continuous passive: 'was/were + being + past participle'.
questions.question: The car ___ being repaired when I arrived.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'was/were + past participle'.
questions.question: The letter ___ by the postman yesterday.

questions.def: Future simple passive: 'will be + past participle'.
questions.question: The house ___ next year.

questions.def: Past simple passive, plural subject.
questions.question: Mistakes ___ made, but we can learn from them.

questions.def: Past simple passive – action finished.
questions.question: The cake ___ while we were out.

questions.def: Present simple passive: 'are + past participle'.
questions.question: The windows ___ every week.

questions.def: Present perfect passive: 'has/have been + past participle'.
questions.question: The room ___ already been cleaned.

questions.def: Past simple passive - a completed action.
questions.question: The problem ___ by the team.

questions.def: Present continuous passive: 'is being + past participle'.
questions.question: My car ___ at the moment.

questions.def: Present perfect passive (negative, plural subject).
questions.question: The keys ___ found yet.

questions.def: Past simple passive – completed action in the past.
questions.question: The money ___ yesterday.

questions.def: Future simple passive: 'will be + past participle'.
questions.question: The email ___ tomorrow.

questions.def: Past simple passive, plural subject.
questions.question: The books ___ put on the table.

questions.def: Past simple passive - identifying the agent.
questions.question: The mistake ___ by him.

questions.def: Present perfect passive: 'has/have been + past participle'.
questions.question: The pizza ___ already.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous passive (rare, but possible).
questions.question: The meeting ___ being planned for weeks.

questions.def: Past simple passive, singular subject.
questions.question: The door ___ locked last night.

questions.def: Past simple passive: 'was/were + past participle'.
questions.question: The book ___ by him.

questions.def: Present continuous passive, plural subject.
questions.question: The dogs ___ being fed right now.

questions.def: Past simple passive, singular subject.
questions.question: The film ___ directed by him.

questions.def: Present simple passive: 'is/are + past participle'.
questions.question: English ___ in this school.

questions.def: Past simple passive, plural subject.
questions.question: The flowers ___ watered yesterday.

questions.def: Past simple passive, singular subject.
questions.question: The game ___ watched by many people.

questions.def: Past passive: The dishes received the action of washing.
questions.question: The dishes ___ by my brother.

questions.def: Past passive: The report received the action of writing in the past.
questions.question: The report ___ by the team last week.

questions.def: Past passive: Use 'was' + past participle for completed actions.
questions.question: The house ___ last year.

questions.def: Present continuous passive: The problem is receiving the action now.
questions.question: The problem ___ being discussed now.

questions.def: Present continuous passive: 'is being' + past participle.
questions.question: The cake ___ by my mom right now.

questions.def: Present simple passive: 'is' + past participle for regular actions.
questions.question: The room ___ every day.

questions.def: Past passive: 'was' agrees with the singular subject 'movie'.
questions.question: The movie ___ directed by him.
